authority: Independent synthetic expectations specified for policy review before detector execution; not production approval.

policy_meanings.P1: Any positively owned requested action, full technical scope, verified same source, no denial/ambiguity.
policy_meanings.P2: Creation plus upstream design or requested downstream lifecycle stewardship, with the common safeguards.
policy_meanings.P3: Design plus creation on the exact required artifact/scope; only the required lifecycle action may be absent, with no explicit denial.
policy_meanings.P4: No newly governed partial credit; review partial configurations.
